objective: Infer uncertainty in common event correspondences and token emission reliability using only public training streams, not the generator's retained indices

fit.selector: frozen baseline eight-match marginal, trained permutation from prior unsupervised public streams

synthetic_deletions.lengths: 8..12; no insertion indices passed to learner

estimated_model.method: sum-product alignment expectation-semiring EM on pseudo-positive candidates from frozen old selector; three iterations; no true alignment, labels or heldout feedback

baselines: fixed source learned from train navigation reward
oracle cipher with learned variable-count model
metrics: per-episode latent matched-event posterior and generator-only true common event count scoring
constraints: Do not edit old benchmarks, train splits or prior results
Freeze all fit/eval seeds, parameters and comparisons before test execution
Previously inspected cohorts are not blind
No hidden generator drop indices, token cipher, correct candidate or positions to learner or EM fit
No candidate promotion or system actions
